verdict.rationale:
Sentry ships a built-in AI agent, Seer, described as a 'debugging agent and code reviewer' that can autofix issues, root-cause problems, and perform AI code review — clearly a delegate-able in-product assistant rather than an external tool. This is documented across product marketing and changelog pages, with pricing confirming it as a distinct subscription feature.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of actually delegating tasks to Seer and confirmation of the scope of tasks it can autonomously handle beyond docs claims.
